active_work_item.title: Deterministic trust evaluation harness
active_work_item.depends_on: CP6-01 independently QA-passed and merged via PR #13 at 387b94a17270d3b660534f80deaa846bb818ca3f
active_work_item.reason: Builder repaired both Independent QA defects on PR #16. The evaluator now rejects explicit fact/difference claims whose structured numeric/domain anchors are not supported by their cited canonical excerpts, including a fabricated $900 disposal-fee claim borrowing a real total excerpt. Ambiguous/unreadable extraction must now remain field/evidence-specific through the report summary or a matching-evidence inference; a generic confidence limitation containing 'uncertain' no longer satisfies preservation. New deterministic regression fixtures/tests cover both failures while existing grounded cases remain passing. Exact-head CI run 34638683474 passed install, lint, typecheck, deterministic tests/evals, and production build at d37b1b2cd9e8fb644c1de228d0eb965ea63080b5. Ready for Independent QA.

commercial_milestone: A stranger can upload 2-3 quotes, receive a useful preview, unlock a complete report, and receive grounded analysis without fabricated findings
